comments.author: Hans
comments.body: Alright, well I've finally obtained the book, though it was still very odd... Checking in multiple ports didn't get me this book, neither did checking both craft and item shop, and even though it's obvious, yes I scanned through the entire inventory. I did however obtain it, strangely enough by buying it in the London item shop, not myself, I had to have my company leader buy it for me, and to be honest there's no telling how much he's invested by now... Still I thank you all for your help, if nothing else the information alone is invaluable, I appreciate all of your assistance with this. We'll chat sometime DreadPirate, I think I may know you from game...
